study_design: Case-control studies of prostate cancer patients and controls in Japan, Korea, and the United States.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The number of subjects was 295 in Japan (133 patients and 162 controls), 122 in Korea (61 patients and 61 controls) and 45 in the United States (24 patients and 21 controls).
reason: The abstract compares equol-producer status between prostate cancer patients and controls but does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The percentage of equol producers among patients and controls was 29% and 46% in Japan (P = 0.004) and 30% and 59% in Korea (P = 0.001), respectively.
estimate_classifications.reason: The Japan comparison is between prostate cancer patients and controls without an aggressive disease definition.
